children: Kingfisher had a mixed performance across Europe, with France remaining weak, analysts at Berenberg say in a note. The country's Castorama and Brico Depot businesses both posted a profit slip on a like-for-like basis, but retail profit for France rose, as the contraction was offset by a gross margin uplift and operating cost management, the analysts add. Kingfisher's sales performances in Poland and Iberia were more positive, showing strong increases in retail profit for the divisions. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
